Testimonials

FAQ

Agent Jesse crawls the live internet in real-time — permit filings, conference pages, LinkedIn posts, news articles, job boards, and hundreds of other public sources. Unlike Apollo or ZoomInfo which store stale middleware data, Agent Jesse finds leads who are actively in-market right now based on contextual signals. That's why Agent Jesse surfaces buyers that no static database can.

The Free Tier includes 1,000 Agent Jesse Credits, live people & company search, saved lists, and 1 daily alert — no credit card required. Email and phone enrichment unlock on Pro, Business, and Max.

After a search completes, click "Find Contacts" and pick the roles you care about — VP of Sales, Head of Marketing, CTO, etc. Agent Jesse uses AI to suggest the best roles based on your ICP. For smaller companies where senior titles don't exist, it automatically finds founders and leadership instead.

Agent Jesse uses multi-step verification including syntax checks, domain validation, and real-time SMTP verification. Our average email deliverability rate is above 95%. Every lead is checked before it reaches your inbox so you never waste time on bounced emails.

CRM integrations are on the way! We're currently building native integrations with Zapier, HubSpot, and Salesforce. For now, you can easily export your leads as a CSV from any saved list. Business and Max plans also include MCP, n8n, and API access.

Apollo and ZoomInfo rely on static, middleware databases — data that's often stale by the time you use it. Agent Jesse crawls the live internet in real-time to find leads who are actually in-market today. It discovers prospects from live signals like construction permits, conference attendance, funding announcements, and hiring activity — not yesterday's data.

Yes, absolutely. There are no contracts or commitments. You can cancel your paid plan at any time from your dashboard and you won't be charged again.

Join 1,200+ sales teams that use Agent Jesse to grow their pipeline on auto-pilot. Start free with 1,000 credits — no credit card required.
